description_en: This operation pauses a DBS backup plan
description_zh: 该接口用于暂停一个DBS备份计划
kebab_example: aliyun dbs stop-backup-plan --backup-plan-id dbstooi01XXXX --stop-method ALL --api-version 2019-03-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: StopBackupPlan

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup plan
parameters.name: backup_plan_id

parameters.help_en:
The method used to pause the backup plan. Valid values:

ALL: Pauses the backup schedule, full data backup jobs, incremental log backup jobs, and restore jobs.

PLAN: Pauses only the backup schedule
parameters.help_zh:
暂停方式，取值：
ALL：暂停备份计划、全量数据备份任务、增量日志备份任务、恢复任务
PLAN：只暂停备份计划
parameters.name: stop_method

parameters.help_en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. This prevents the same request from being sent repeatedly
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求
parameters.name: client_token
